data.desc: Cricut, Inc. is a creative platform company that makes it easy for users to create meaningful personal items. Cricut Design Space is the software experience that powers Cricut's ecosystem of products and services. These industry-leading products include a flagship line of smart cutting machines - the Cricut Maker family, the Cricut Explore family, and the Cricut Joy family - accompanied by an extensive line of Cricut heat presses like Cricut EasyPress, the all-new Cricut StickerPix line, and a diverse collection of materials. In addition to providing products and services, Cricut fosters a thriving community of millions of dedicated users worldwide.
